_chunking.why: ⭐⭐ THE CHUNK IS THE UNIT OF BOX ASSIGNMENT AND OF PROVENANCE (DESIGN §6.3/§6.4). It is not a convenience: eval_fair_puct writes manifest.json at run START and summary.json at run END, so a run killed mid-flight has the first and not the second. With ONE out-dir for the whole band, stopping the laptop to add local would destroy that dir's summary and clobber it on the next launch. With chunks, a killed chunk is RESUMED (its per-game records are cached-skipped by the harness), every completed chunk carries a full manifest+summary pair, and a box change can only land on a chunk BOUNDARY — which is what makes 'which box played which range' exactly answerable. ⛔ THE WHOLE CLAIM IS ONE BAND AND ONE POOLED READ; the chunks are execution, not measurement.
_chunking.⛔ still ONE band: The 8 chunks are ONE cell on ONE band, pooled by ONE read. That is a WITHIN-band, deck-paired pool — the class CL-068 leaves robust — and it is NOT a statistical combination of separate measurements.

(b) UNTRACKED files -> exactly ONE filesystem pass over the MAIN TREE's non-tracked files. ⚠️⚠️ THIS HALF MUST BE RUN AGAINST THE MAIN TREE, NOT A WORKTREE: a git worktree has its own index and reports ZERO untracked files, so a sweep run from a worktree silently skips (b) entirely.
